snippet.title: PLUM | [Trailer] - Wishlist on steam !! 💛 (Out soon - end of 2026)
snippet.description:
💛 Let's discover Plum, a short 3d cozy plateformer game available for windows/pc on steam with this gameplay trailer.
💛 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5061060/Plum/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=wishlist

💛 Plum is a short adventure made by an indie solo dev.
The game is about following the journey of a plum, meeting some npcs, collecting stuff while rolling and bouncing trough the way.
